name: Agriculture Almanac
description: An open, versioned index of public agriculture data.

entries.title: FAOSTAT
entries.description: The UN Food and Agriculture Organization's global statistical database covering agricultural production, trade, land use, and food security for nearly every country and territory.
entries.publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)
entries.notes: Verified reachable this session (HTTP 200). Bulk downloads available via FAOSTAT's own bulk-download API in addition to the interactive browser. Seeded as this vertical's first international (non-US) source per operator request to seed the new verticals international-first.

entries.title: USDA FAS Production, Supply and Distribution (PSD Online)
entries.description: USDA's official country-by-country estimates and forecasts of production, consumption, trade, and stocks for major agricultural commodities worldwide — the data behind the monthly WASDE and World Agricultural Production reports.
entries.publisher: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Foreign Agricultural Service (USDA FAS)

coverage.temporal: varies by commodity (decades of marketing years)

entries.attribution: USDA Foreign Agricultural Service, Production, Supply and Distribution database
entries.notes: Human-verified 2026-10-31: app loads (HTTP 200); the Reports and Data view lists zipped CSV bulk downloads (e.g. https://apps.fas.usda.gov/psdonline/downloads/psd_alldata_csv.zip) and the release schedule. A US agency's estimates of global production, so jurisdiction is national (US) even though coverage is global.
